ABSTRACT
Date of Publication:
07 July 2025
Key Terms:
Setting,
Realism,
Characterization, Character. Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined. The study that informed this article aimed to examine the depiction of setting in Mohamed S. Mohamed's novel *Kiu* and Ken Walibora's novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Although the research had three specific objectives, this article focuses on just one objective—to assess the contribution of setting to the construction of character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements. This evaluative study was conducted in the library, employing an analytical design. The research area is written literature, specifically the genre of the Swahili novel. The target population of the study comprises 10 realist novels that depict authentic settings. A sample of two novels, *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, was selected through purposive sampling. These novels were selected based on the abundance of the aspects under investigation, namely the depiction of setting. In addition to reflecting the objectives of the study, the composition of the selected novels aligns with the framework of the combined theoretical approaches. The primary data for the study was collected through intensive reading of the texts of the selected novels. Secondary data was collected through intensive reading of books, theses, and various academic articles. The collected data was categorized according to the theoretical frameworks and objectives of the study. They were analyzed according to their content and the results presented descriptively. The findings of the study indicate that settings have a direct contribution to the development of characters' traits. These settings include: spatial settings (such as the banks of the Kiberenge River, the room of Chief Nasaba Bora, the forest, the cell, Mzee Mwinyi's room, and neighborhoods such as Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, and others) and temporal settings (the colonial era, five-year periods, the Second World War, and so on). These settings were skillfully crafted in a way that greatly facilitated the development of the characters' traits. The findings of this study are beneficial to novelists and literary critics in general. They will help them craft stories that portray and reflect authentic settings. INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars. For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell. The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions. Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery. Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it. Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there. Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development. A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work. Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work. In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work. This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS  
Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. This allowed us to identify some of the traits of different characters and thus helped us fulfill the objective of this study, which is to assess the contribution of setting in constructing character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The objectives of the study were guided by the combination of two theories, namely, the theory of Realism and the theory of Structuralism. The theory of Realism emerged in the nineteenth century (Ntarangwi, 2004). The term 'uhalisia' is a translation of the English word 'realism', which was originally used to refer to a branch of philosophy concerned with matters related to human perception. Currently, this term is used to refer to two meanings: the first is one that evaluates the state of life, that is, the reality in literature which signifies the skill of composition and describes events according to objectivity; and the second meaning is the actual condition of human life. The theory of Structuralism is often associated with the Prague linguists (Mwangi, 2005). It emphasizes the elements of an artistic work such as plot, message, characters, context, language, and how these interact to complete the work in question. This theory examines the relationships among the various components of literary compositions, such as structural narrative analysis. The theory focuses on the narration of an artistic work. For instance, structural analysis of a novel considers the novel as a self-contained work possessing structural elements such as plot, characters, and various narrative techniques that interrelate and depend on each other. The pillars of the theory of Structuralism include:
• Writers and critics of realism consider that the role of the author should be to depict reality as it appears in the respective society. • Any literary work has a structure that is self-sufficient in its various interconnected parts, which come together to form a single complete system (plot). • Realists believed that a writer was required to provide a complete picture of their society as it truly is, without exaggerating or diminishing it. • Structuralists explain that particular functions of literature should be considered, for example, the use of language targeting the individual and that depend on the rules of the literary language system and language in general. Therefore, the first principle of Structuralism helped us identify how settings contribute to bringing out key elements of the plot as well as the traits of various characters in the selected novels analyzed. Tathmini yenyewe inajikita katika mchanganyiko wa nadharia mbili—Uhalisia na Ustrukturalisimu. Nadharia ya Uhalisia inachunguza uhalisia wa mandhari ya kijamii, ilhali Ustrukturalisimu unasisitiza kazi na uhusiano kati ya vipengele vya kisanaa. Utafiti huu wa tathmini ulifanyika katika maktaba, ukitumia muundo wa kianaliti. Eneo la utafiti ni fasihi andishi, hasa aina ya riwaya ya Kiswahili. Walengwa wa utafiti ni riwaya kumi za uhalisia zinazoonyesha mandhari halisi. Mfano wa riwaya mbili, *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, uliteuliwa kwa kutumia usampulishaji makusudi. Riwaya hizi zilichaguliwa kwa misingi ya wingi wa vipengele vinavyochunguzwa, yaani uchoraji wa mandhari. Mbali na kuakisi malengo ya utafiti, mkusanyiko wa riwaya zilizoteuliwa unaendana na mfumo wa mbinu za nadharia zilizochanganywa. Data ya msingi ya utafiti ilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa maandishi ya riwaya zilizoteuliwa. Data ya upili ilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa vitabu, tasnifu, na makala mbalimbali za kitaaluma. Data iliyokusanywa iligawanywa kulingana na mifumo ya nadharia na malengo ya utafiti. Vichambuzi vilifanywa kulingana na maudhui yake na matokeo yakaoneshwa kimaelezo. Matokeo ya utafiti yanaonesha kuwa mandhari yana mchango wa moja kwa moja katika ukuzaji wa tabia za wahusika. Mandhari hizi zinajumuisha: mandhari za mahali (kama vile kingo za Mto Kiberenge, chumba cha Chifu Nasaba Bora, msitu, selo, chumba cha Mzee Mwinyi, na maeneo kama Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, na mengineyo) na mandhari za muda (kipindi cha ukoloni, vipindi vya miaka mitano mitano, Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia, na kadhalika). Kazi ya fasihi hujengwa kwa kutumia vipengele mbalimbali vya kisanii, kikiwemo kipengele cha mandhari. Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia katika uundaji na uwasilishaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi. Waandishi wengi hutumia mandhari kufikisha ujumbe wao kwa msomaji. Kipengele cha mandhari kimefafanuliwa na wataalamu mbalimbali. Kwa mfano, Wamitila (2008) anafafanua mandhari kama kipengele kinachomfunulia msomaji mahali na wakati ambapo matukio fulani yalitokea. Mandhari inaweza kuwa halisi au ya kubuniwa. Mandhari halisi inahusiana na maeneo ambayo yapo katika ulimwengu wa kweli. Kwa mfano, mandhari kama vile msituni, chuoni, nyumbani, ofisini, mjini na kwenye maeneo ya ibada. Mandhari ya kubuniwa inahusu mazingira yasiyo ya kawaida na mengi hukutwa kupitia ndoto. Mifano ya mandhari ya kubuniwa ni kama peponi, kuzimu, na motoni. Mandhari inayochorwa kwa msomaji hubaki akilini mwake. Waandishi wengi, wanapobuni kazi zao, huziweka katika mandhari tofauti ili kutimiza malengo mbalimbali ya kifasihi na kisanaa. Hivyo basi, ni sahihi kusema kwamba mandhari ni nguzo kuu katika uundaji wa kazi za kisanaa. Mandhari inaathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa aina mbalimbali za taswira kuhusu kile ambacho mwandishi alikusudia kuwasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). Taswira hizi zinaweza kuwa, kwa mfano: taswira ya kuona, ambayo inampa msomaji uwezo wa ‘kuona’ kile ambacho mwandishi anaelezea kupitia maneno; taswira ya mwendo, inayomsaidia msomaji kupata uzoefu wa tukio ‘lililo katika mwendo’ kulingana na mandhari ambamo tukio hilo linatokea; taswira ya hisia, ambapo msomaji anapitia hisia mbalimbali za wahusika ndani ya muktadha wakati mwandishi anachunguza hisia hizo; taswira ya ladha, ambayo msomaji anahisi katika mandhari ambako matendo yanachochea msisimko wa kutamani ladha; na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira ya kusikia. Kwa kuchukua mfano wa eneo la Selea, linaloonekana katika riwaya ya *Kiu*, mwandishi anatueleza kwamba lilikuwa ni mahali (mandhari) palipojaa umasikini uliokithiri na matatizo mengi; wakaazi waliishi katika vibanda na wengine katika vyumba vilivyopakwa udongo, na barabara ya kufika huko ilikuwa mbaya kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi halikuweza kufika. Wahusika kama Bahati na mama yake Chausiku, ambao waliishi katika mtaa huu, pia walikuwa maskini. Hii inaonesha kuwa mandhari yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa wahusika hawa na tabia zao. Walikuwa maskini, ndiyo maana waliishi hapo. Wamitila (2002) anafafanua kuwa mandhari humjulisha msomaji kuhusu safari ya mhusika kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho wa hadithi. Hivyo, msomaji anaelewa mhusika katika kila eneo na katika kila hatua ya maendeleo yake. Mfano mzuri ni mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu katika riwaya ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, ambaye tunasimuliwa kuhusu utoto wake, masomo yake ng’ambo, kujihusisha kwake na ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria masomo katika shule ya Nasaba Bora, kufukuzwa kazi na kupata ajira nyingine, kujiingiza katika wizi wa maandishi ya waandishi, na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara alipokuwa ameitwa Wangwani. Hapa, tunapewa sifa kadhaa za mhusika huyu kupitia mandhari mbalimbali—kwamba alikuwa msomi, mlevi, mwizi wa kazi za kitaaluma, na mzembe katika kazi yake. Tabia za wahusika mara nyingi husaidia kumtambua na kumtofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi. Tabia hizi huonyesha mara kwa mara mazoea yao, mwenendo, au hata hulka yao ndani ya kazi husika ya fasihi. Katika muktadha huu, mandhari ina jukumu muhimu katika kuonesha tabia za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiwango kikubwa, wahusika huathiriwa na mandhari wanamooneshwa. Baadhi ya kazi za kifasihi huonesha mandhari ya umasikini, matatizo mengi, na wahusika wanaoishi katika vibanda na vyumba vilivyopakwa udongo, sambamba na usafiri unaotegemea barabara duni. Hii ina maana kwamba mandhari anayoichora msanii ina athari ya moja kwa moja katika ujenzi wa tabia za wahusika katika kazi husika. Hili ndilo suala lililochunguzwa katika utafiti uliozaa makala hii. Lengo kuu lilikuwa kuchunguza uwasilishaji wa mandhari katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ili kubainisha uhusiano kati ya mandhari na tabia za wahusika. Kupitia tathmini, hoja kuu ya makala hii ni kwamba mandhari wanamokutwa wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* huchangia katika uundaji wa tabia zao. Imebainika kuwa mandhari pia huathiri namna baadhi ya wahusika wanavyooneshwa. Mandhari ina mchango mkubwa katika kuwapa wahusika tabia fulani (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiwango fulani, muda na mahali ambapo mhusika anajikuta vinaashiria na kuathiri uwasilishaji wa tabia zao. Hivyo, makala hii inachunguza uhusiano kati ya mandhari na tabia za wahusika katika kazi hizi mbili na inaonesha wazi kuwepo kwa uhusiano huo pamoja na jinsi waandishi hawa walivyowachora wahusika wao.

MTINDO WA UANDISHI
Wamitila (2002) anasema kuwa mandhari ina mchango mkubwa katika uwasilishaji wa tabia za wahusika. Anafafanua kuwa wahusika huathiriwa sana na mazingira yao wanamoishi. MISINGI YA KINADHARIA  
Kupitia nguzo ya pili ya nadharia ya Uhalisia, utafiti huu ulitathmini jinsi waandishi wa vitabu hivi vilivyochaguliwa walivyoonyesha uhalisia katika kazi zao kupitia matumizi mbalimbali ya mandhari. Hii ilitusaidia kubaini baadhi ya tabia za wahusika tofauti na hivyo kutusaidia kutimiza lengo la utafiti huu, ambalo ni kutathmini mchango wa mandhari katika uundaji wa tabia za wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Malengo ya utafiti yaliongozwa na uchanganuzi wa nadharia mbili, ambazo ni nadharia ya Uhalisia na nadharia ya Ustrukturalisimu. Nadharia ya Uhalisia ilijitokeza katika karne ya kumi na tisa (Ntarangwi, 2004). Neno 'uhalisia' ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza 'realism', ambalo awali lilitumika kurejelea tawi la falsafa linalohusika na masuala yanayohusiana na mtazamo wa binadamu. Kwa sasa, neno hili hutumika kurejelea maana mbili: ya kwanza ni ile inayopima hali ya maisha, yaani, uhalisia katika fasihi ambao unaashiria ustadi wa uandishi na kuelezea matukio kwa mujibu wa uhalisia; na maana ya pili ni hali halisi ya maisha ya binadamu. Nadharia ya Ustrukturalisimu mara nyingi inahusishwa na wanaisimu wa Prague (Mwangi, 2005). Inasisitiza vipengele vya kazi ya kisanaa kama vile msuko, ujumbe, wahusika, muktadha, lugha, na jinsi vipengele hivi vinavyoshirikiana kukamilisha kazi husika. Nadharia hii huchunguza uhusiano miongoni mwa sehemu mbalimbali za utunzi wa fasihi, kama vile uchanganuzi wa muundo wa simulizi. Nadharia hii inazingatia simulizi katika kazi ya kisanaa. Kwa mfano, uchanganuzi wa kimuundo wa riwaya huchukulia riwaya kama kazi inayojitegemea yenye vipengele vya kimuundo kama vile msuko, wahusika, na mbinu mbalimbali za kisimulizi ambazo zote zinahusiana na kutegemeana. MBINU ZA UTAFITI  
Data ya utafiti wa kazi hii ilichanganuliwa kulingana na maudhui yake ili kubaini aina mbalimbali za mandhari katika riwaya teule na mchango wake katika kukuza tabia za wahusika tofauti katika riwaya hizo. Baada ya uchanganuzi wa data, matokeo yakaoneshwa kimaelezo. Uchanganuzi wenyewe ulifanywa kwa kufuata malengo na mifumo ya nadharia iliyouongoza utafiti. Ufafanuzi ni mbinu ya uchanganuzi inayomwezesha mtafiti kusoma au kusikiliza kazi ya fasihi, kuelewa maudhui yake, mitazamo ya kifalsafa ya kazi husika, pamoja na mambo mengine muhimu (Adam, 2014). JINSI MANDHARI INAVYOBADILI TABIA ZA WAHUSIKA KATIKA RIWAYA ZA UHALISIA  
Mandhari ina jukumu kubwa katika kuunda baadhi ya tabia za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiwango fulani, mahali na muda ambao mhusika anajikuta vinaashiria na kuathiri namna tabia zao zinavyooneshwa. Utafiti huu wa tathmini ulitumia muundo wa utafiti wa uchanganuzi. Utafiti wa uchanganuzi huchunguza vigezo kwa undani ili kufikia hitimisho linalofaa (Read, 1987). Mfumo huu ulituruhusu kukusanya, kuchambua, na kufafanua matokeo kulingana na matokeo ya utafiti huu, hivyo kutusaidia kufikia hitimisho linalofaa. Riwaya mbili kati ya kumi za uhalisia zilizolengwa zilichaguliwa kimaksudi. Hii ni sampuli ya makusudi, ambapo sampuli huchaguliwa kwa msingi wa kuwa na sifa maalum zinazohitajika katika utafiti. Sampuli ya makusudi mara nyingi huhusisha uteuzi wa kundi linalowakilisha la wahusika, vitu, au dhana zinazolingana na vigezo vinavyochunguzwa (Kombo & Tromp, 2006). Kwa hiyo, riwaya zilizochaguliwa ziliendana na malengo na mifumo ya nadharia ya utafiti, na ndiyo maana zilichaguliwa kimakusudi kwa ajili hiyo. Tabia za wahusika mara nyingi husaidia kutambua na kutofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi zaidi; tabia hizi huonesha mwelekeo wa mhusika, mwenendo, au hata hulka yake katika kazi husika ya fasihi. Kwa mfano, katika *Kiu*, mazingira ya nyumbani ya Mzee Mwinyi yanaoneshwa kwa namna ambayo chumba chake kilikuwa na zulia na pambo la thamani. Zaidi ya hayo, alikuwa na gari la Mercedes Benz, jambo linaloashiria kwamba alikuwa na utajiri mkubwa na hivyo basi alikuwa tajiri mkubwa. Sehemu ndogo zifuatazo zimetumika kuchanganua na kujadili kila riwaya moja baada ya nyingine, kuanzia na uundaji wa tabia za wahusika katika *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Usomaji makini unajumuisha mikakati kama vile kuchora mstari chini ya maneno yasiyoeleweka, kuangazia hoja kuu, kuandika mawazo yanayotokana na usomaji, kuandika maswali, kuchunguza uhusiano au mwingiliano uliomo kwenye maandishi, pamoja na kuchambua nafasi ya msimulizi (Rief, 2012). Kwa msingi wa uchanganuzi huu, inapendekezwa kwamba utafiti wa baadaye uchunguze masuala kama vile: jinsi mandhari inavyokuza maendeleo ya vipengele vingine vya sanaa katika riwaya hizi au riwaya nyingine; pamoja na mchango wa mandhari katika ukuzaji wa msuko wa hadithi, wahusika, na dhamira katika tanzu nyingine kama vile ushairi, tamthilia, riwaya fupi, na hadithi fupi kwa kutumia mbinu mbalimbali za nadharia. discourses.source_txt: Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari hufafanuliwa kama muda na mahali ambapo matukio, visa, au hatua hutokea katika kazi fulani ya fasihi. Mandhari inaweza kuwa halisi au iliyobuniwa.

discourses.source_txt: The study that informed this article aimed to examine the depiction of setting in Mohamed S. Mohamed's novel *Kiu* and Ken Walibora's novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Although the research had three specific objectives, this article focuses on just one objective—to assess the contribution of setting to the construction of character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.
discourses.translated_txt: Utafiti ulioleta makala hii ulikusudia kuchunguza uwasilishaji wa mandhari katika riwaya ya *Kiu* iliyoandikwa na Mohamed S. Mohamed na riwaya ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ya Ken Walibora. Ingawa utafiti huu ulikuwa na malengo mahsusi matatu, makala hii inajikita kwenye lengo moja tu—kuchunguza mchango wa mandhari katika uundaji wa sifa za wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.

discourses.source_txt: The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements.
discourses.translated_txt: Tathmini yenyewe inajikita katika mchanganyiko wa nadharia mbili—Uhalisia na Ustrukturalisimu. Nadharia ya Uhalisia inachunguza uhalisia wa mandhari ya kijamii, ilhali Ustrukturalisimu unasisitiza kazi na uhusiano kati ya vipengele vya kisanaa.

discourses.source_txt: This evaluative study was conducted in the library, employing an analytical design. The research area is written literature, specifically the genre of the Swahili novel. The target population of the study comprises 10 realist novels that depict authentic settings.
discourses.translated_txt: Utafiti huu wa tathmini ulifanyika katika maktaba, ukitumia muundo wa kianaliti. Eneo la utafiti ni fasihi andishi, hasa aina ya riwaya ya Kiswahili. Walengwa wa utafiti ni riwaya kumi za uhalisia zinazoonyesha mandhari halisi.

discourses.source_txt: A sample of two novels, *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, was selected through purposive sampling.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfano wa riwaya mbili, *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, uliteuliwa kwa kutumia usampulishaji makusudi.

discourses.source_txt: These novels were selected based on the abundance of the aspects under investigation, namely the depiction of setting. In addition to reflecting the objectives of the study, the composition of the selected novels aligns with the framework of the combined theoretical approaches. The primary data for the study was collected through intensive reading of the texts of the selected novels.
discourses.translated_txt: Riwaya hizi zilichaguliwa kwa misingi ya wingi wa vipengele vinavyochunguzwa, yaani uchoraji wa mandhari. Mbali na kuakisi malengo ya utafiti, mkusanyiko wa riwaya zilizoteuliwa unaendana na mfumo wa mbinu za nadharia zilizochanganywa. Data ya msingi ya utafiti ilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa maandishi ya riwaya zilizoteuliwa.

discourses.source_txt: Secondary data was collected through intensive reading of books, theses, and various academic articles. The collected data was categorized according to the theoretical frameworks and objectives of the study.
discourses.translated_txt: Data ya upili ilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa vitabu, tasnifu, na makala mbalimbali za kitaaluma. Data iliyokusanywa iligawanywa kulingana na mifumo ya nadharia na malengo ya utafiti.

discourses.source_txt: They were analyzed according to their content and the results presented descriptively. The findings of the study indicate that settings have a direct contribution to the development of characters' traits.
discourses.translated_txt: Vichambuzi vilifanywa kulingana na maudhui yake na matokeo yakaoneshwa kimaelezo. Matokeo ya utafiti yanaonesha kuwa mandhari yana mchango wa moja kwa moja katika ukuzaji wa tabia za wahusika.

discourses.source_txt: These settings include: spatial settings (such as the banks of the Kiberenge River, the room of Chief Nasaba Bora, the forest, the cell, Mzee Mwinyi's room, and neighborhoods such as Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, and others) and temporal settings (the colonial era, five-year periods, the Second World War, and so on).
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari hizi zinajumuisha: mandhari za mahali (kama vile kingo za Mto Kiberenge, chumba cha Chifu Nasaba Bora, msitu, selo, chumba cha Mzee Mwinyi, na maeneo kama Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, na mengineyo) na mandhari za muda (kipindi cha ukoloni, vipindi vya miaka mitano mitano, Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia, na kadhalika).

discourses.source_txt: These settings were skillfully crafted in a way that greatly facilitated the development of the characters' traits.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari hizi zilitengenezwa kwa ustadi mkubwa kiasi kwamba ziliwezesha sana ukuzaji wa tabia za wahusika.

discourses.source_txt: The findings of this study are beneficial to novelists and literary critics in general. They will help them craft stories that portray and reflect authentic settings. Furthermore, literary critics will be enabled to identify and evaluate various settings along with their roles in literary works.
discourses.translated_txt: Matokeo ya utafiti huu ni yenye manufaa kwa waandishi wa riwaya na wakosoaji wa fasihi kwa ujumla. Yatawasaidia kubuni hadithi zinazoonesha na kuakisi mandhari halisi. Vilevile, wakosoaji wa fasihi watawezeshwa kutambua na kutathmini mandhari mbalimbali pamoja na nafasi zake katika kazi za fasihi.

discourses.source_txt:
INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars.
discourses.translated_txt:
UTANGULIZI  
Kazi ya fasihi hujengwa kwa kutumia vipengele mbalimbali vya kisanii, kikiwemo kipengele cha mandhari. Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia katika uundaji na uwasilishaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi. Waandishi wengi hutumia mandhari kufikisha ujumbe wao kwa msomaji. Kipengele cha mandhari kimefafanuliwa na wataalamu mbalimbali.

discourses.source_txt: For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa mfano, Wamitila (2008) anafafanua mandhari kama kipengele kinachomfunulia msomaji mahali na wakati ambapo matukio fulani yalitokea. Mandhari inaweza kuwa halisi au ya kubuniwa. Mandhari halisi inahusiana na maeneo ambayo yapo katika ulimwengu wa kweli. Kwa mfano, mandhari kama vile msituni, chuoni, nyumbani, ofisini, mjini na kwenye maeneo ya ibada. Mandhari ya kubuniwa inahusu mazingira yasiyo ya kawaida na mengi hukutwa kupitia ndoto. Mifano ya mandhari ya kubuniwa ni kama peponi, kuzimu, na motoni.

discourses.source_txt: The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari inayochorwa kwa msomaji hubaki akilini mwake. Waandishi wengi, wanapobuni kazi zao, huziweka katika mandhari tofauti ili kutimiza malengo mbalimbali ya kifasihi na kisanaa. Hivyo basi, ni sahihi kusema kwamba mandhari ni nguzo kuu katika uundaji wa kazi za kisanaa.

discourses.source_txt: Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari inaathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa aina mbalimbali za taswira kuhusu kile ambacho mwandishi alikusudia kuwasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). Taswira hizi zinaweza kuwa, kwa mfano: taswira ya kuona, ambayo inampa msomaji uwezo wa ‘kuona’ kile ambacho mwandishi anaelezea kupitia maneno; taswira ya mwendo, inayomsaidia msomaji kupata uzoefu wa tukio ‘lililo katika mwendo’ kulingana na mandhari ambamo tukio hilo linatokea; taswira ya hisia, ambapo msomaji anapitia hisia mbalimbali za wahusika ndani ya muktadha wakati mwandishi anachunguza hisia hizo; taswira ya ladha, ambayo msomaji anahisi katika mandhari ambako matendo yanachochea msisimko wa kutamani ladha; na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira ya kusikia.

discourses.source_txt: Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kuchukua mfano wa eneo la Selea, linaloonekana katika riwaya ya *Kiu*, mwandishi anatueleza kwamba lilikuwa ni mahali (mandhari) palipojaa umasikini uliokithiri na matatizo mengi; wakaazi waliishi katika vibanda na wengine katika vyumba vilivyopakwa udongo, na barabara ya kufika huko ilikuwa mbaya kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi halikuweza kufika.

discourses.source_txt: Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there.
discourses.translated_txt: Wahusika kama Bahati na mama yake Chausiku, ambao waliishi katika mtaa huu, pia walikuwa maskini. Hii inaonesha kuwa mandhari yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa wahusika hawa na tabia zao. Walikuwa maskini, ndiyo maana waliishi hapo.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development.
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2002) anafafanua kuwa mandhari humjulisha msomaji kuhusu safari ya mhusika kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho wa hadithi. Hivyo, msomaji anaelewa mhusika katika kila eneo na katika kila hatua ya maendeleo yake.

discourses.source_txt: A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfano mzuri ni mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu katika riwaya ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, ambaye tunasimuliwa kuhusu utoto wake, masomo yake ng’ambo, kujihusisha kwake na ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria masomo katika shule ya Nasaba Bora, kufukuzwa kazi na kupata ajira nyingine, kujiingiza katika wizi wa maandishi ya waandishi, na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara alipokuwa ameitwa Wangwani. Hapa, tunapewa sifa kadhaa za mhusika huyu kupitia mandhari mbalimbali—kwamba alikuwa msomi, mlevi, mwizi wa kazi za kitaaluma, na mzembe katika kazi yake.

discourses.source_txt: Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work.
discourses.translated_txt: Tabia za wahusika mara nyingi husaidia kumtambua na kumtofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi. Tabia hizi huonyesha mara kwa mara mazoea yao, mwenendo, au hata hulka yao ndani ya kazi husika ya fasihi.

discourses.source_txt: In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work.
discourses.translated_txt: Katika muktadha huu, mandhari ina jukumu muhimu katika kuonesha tabia za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiwango kikubwa, wahusika huathiriwa na mandhari wanamooneshwa. Baadhi ya kazi za kifasihi huonesha mandhari ya umasikini, matatizo mengi, na wahusika wanaoishi katika vibanda na vyumba vilivyopakwa udongo, sambamba na usafiri unaotegemea barabara duni. Hii ina maana kwamba mandhari anayoichora msanii ina athari ya moja kwa moja katika ujenzi wa tabia za wahusika katika kazi husika.

discourses.source_txt:
This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

WRITING STYLE
Wamitila (2002) states that setting makes substantial contributions to the depiction of character traits. He explains that characters are largely influenced by their surroundings. This assertion by Wamitila emerged in this research. In order to depict a character in a particular way, it is essential to examine the setting in which they are found (Wamitila, 2008).
discourses.translated_txt:
Hili ndilo suala lililochunguzwa katika utafiti uliozaa makala hii. Lengo kuu lilikuwa kuchunguza uwasilishaji wa mandhari katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ili kubainisha uhusiano kati ya mandhari na tabia za wahusika. Kupitia tathmini, hoja kuu ya makala hii ni kwamba mandhari wanamokutwa wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* huchangia katika uundaji wa tabia zao. Imebainika kuwa mandhari pia huathiri namna baadhi ya wahusika wanavyooneshwa. Mandhari ina mchango mkubwa katika kuwapa wahusika tabia fulani (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiwango fulani, muda na mahali ambapo mhusika anajikuta vinaashiria na kuathiri uwasilishaji wa tabia zao. Hivyo, makala hii inachunguza uhusiano kati ya mandhari na tabia za wahusika katika kazi hizi mbili na inaonesha wazi kuwepo kwa uhusiano huo pamoja na jinsi waandishi hawa walivyowachora wahusika wao.

MTINDO WA UANDISHI
Wamitila (2002) anasema kuwa mandhari ina mchango mkubwa katika uwasilishaji wa tabia za wahusika. Anafafanua kuwa wahusika huathiriwa sana na mazingira yao wanamoishi. Kauli hii ya Wamitila imejitokeza katika utafiti huu. Ili kumuonesha mhusika katika namna fulani, ni muhimu kuchunguza mandhari anapopatikana (Wamitila, 2008).

discourses.source_txt: This claim was affirmed by this research when the character Majununi was examined in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. We found that this character was used by the author to inform us about a specific historical period, which is the Second World War, and that Majununi was among the British soldiers who fought in this war. Many people died on the battlefield, but he survived.
discourses.translated_txt: Madai haya yalithibitishwa na utafiti huu wakati mhusika Majununi alichunguzwa katika riwaya ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Tuligundua kuwa mhusika huyu alitumika na mwandishi kutufahamisha kuhusu kipindi maalumu cha kihistoria, ambacho ni Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia, na kwamba Majununi alikuwa miongoni mwa askari wa Waingereza waliopigana katika vita hivi. Watu wengi walikufa vitani, lakini yeye alinusurika.

Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. For instance, structural analysis of a novel considers the novel as a self-contained work possessing structural elements such as plot, characters, and various narrative techniques that interrelate and depend on each other.
discourses.translated_txt: Nadharia ya Ustrukturalisimu mara nyingi inahusishwa na wanaisimu wa Prague (Mwangi, 2005). When five years have passed in the marriage, Idi’s antics begin. He would hire workers and dismiss them arbitrarily. One day, when he wanted to fire one of those workers, he is heard saying,
“Five years have passed ... and five years is not a short time for a person whose every moment of life is filled with all sorts of antics.” (Kiu pp. 94–95)
“I have suffered for many years; I will not allow myself to be troubled by a mere cat like you!” (Kiu p. 97)
By hiring and dismissing his workers so capriciously, Idi is revealed as impatient, ungrateful, and lacking in perseverance.
